# Financial Foundation Requirements Checklist: P01

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and traceability of P01 financial-foundation requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [P01 - Financial Backend Foundation](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard, with emphasis on consequential financial and authority requirements.
**Audience / timing**: Requirements reviewer, after planning and before task generation.
**Status**: Unapproved. Every item awaits evidence review.

**Note**: Generated by speckit-checklist for P01 only. Questions assess written requirements and design evidence; they do not establish implementation correctness or executed acceptance results.

Evidence: [phase plan](../plan.md), [approved roadmap](../../../PLAN.md), [constitution](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md), [engineering guides](../../../docs/engineering/README.md) and [CHECKLIST operating contract](../../../docs/workflow/speckit-prompts.txt).

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are P01 deliverables and exclusions explicit for arithmetic, calendar, persistence, financial primitives and reconciliation, with later business workflows assigned to their owning phases? [Completeness, Spec §Roadmap Scope and Gates](../spec.md#roadmap-scope-and-gates-mandatory); [Plan §Summary](../plan.md#summary).
- [ ] CHK002 Are prerequisites distinguished from acceptance gates, including the absence of a predecessor phase and the still-unassessed baseline and isolated database runtime? [Completeness, Spec §Roadmap Scope and Gates](../spec.md#roadmap-scope-and-gates-mandatory); [Plan §Technical Context](../plan.md#technical-context).
- [ ] CHK003 Is the backend-only frontend freeze explicit, preserving existing pages, routes, popups, static copy and presentation while retaining the missing admin-login decision in P03? [Consistency, Spec §Roadmap Scope and Gates](../spec.md#roadmap-scope-and-gates-mandatory); [Constitution §II](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md#ii-approved-frontend-preservation).
- [ ] CHK004 Are permitted intent, financial effect and rejection outcomes documented for each credit, purchase debit, reservation, safe release and correction primitive, without granting public financial authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-015, FR-024, FR-034](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Primitive semantics](../contracts/ledger-service.md#primitive-semantics).
- [ ] CHK005 Are account ownership, trusted user/process identity, mutation authority and observation authority separately specified, including current-state checks and earned credits whose recipient later becomes suspended? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, FR-008, FR-020, FR-023](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Trusted context and identities](../contracts/ledger-service.md#trusted-context-and-identities).

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are canonical amount grammar and accepted/rejected examples explicit for zero balances/results, positive commands and signed movements, including whitespace, signed zero, trailing zeros, excessive precision, numeric and exponent forms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001–FR-003](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Boundary §Amounts and rates](../contracts/financial-boundary.md#amounts-and-rates).
- [ ] CHK007 Are individual component, signed-movement and total-ownership bounds consistently quantified, with overflow/underflow rejection distinguished from a commercial deposit limit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Data model §Storage and relationship rules](../data-model.md#storage-and-relationship-rules).
- [ ] CHK008 Are the 0–10,000 basis-point range, exact floor rule, valid zero derived results and gross/fee/net conservation explicit, while verified credit units retain their original precision? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §SC-001](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Boundary §Amounts and rates](../contracts/financial-boundary.md#amounts-and-rates).
- [ ] CHK009 Are Baghdad business dates, actual instants, task windows, activation, first/final counted work dates, exclusive expiry and earliest new dispatch defined as distinct concepts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027–FR-032](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Plan §Money and time](../plan.md#money-and-time).
- [ ] CHK010 Is the accepted representation and precision of positive counted-hour extensions defined, including exact conversion or explicit rejection when a fractional duration produces a sub-millisecond deadline? [Gap, Clarity, Spec §FR-031, FR-033](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Plan §Test Strategy and Gates, calendar row](../plan.md#test-strategy-and-gates); [Boundary §Sources, dates and identity](../contracts/financial-boundary.md#sources-dates-and-identity).

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do purchase and withdrawal requirements consistently distinguish referral-first spending from eligible non-referral-first reservation, including purchase use of retained referral funds while Free/expired? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011–FR-012](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Roadmap §3.3](../../../PLAN.md#33-wallet-sources-and-spending); [Internal contract §Primitive semantics](../contracts/ledger-service.md#primitive-semantics).
- [ ] CHK012 Are the four source/state components, their ownership total and the entire gross reservation consistent across requirements, mapped results and saved allocations, independently of fee/net calculations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, FR-012–FR-013](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Boundary §Strict result projections](../contracts/financial-boundary.md#strict-result-projections).
- [ ] CHK013 Do debit/reservation and release requirements consistently prevent reuse of reserved funds, conserve ownership and restore identical recorded sources without recalculating allocation or relabeling referral funds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011–FR-014](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §SC-004](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Spec §User Story 2](../spec.md#user-story-2---preserve-fund-sources-through-spending-and-reservation-priority-p1).
- [ ] CHK014 Are correction requirements aligned on current administrator authority, explicit source and direction, available funds only, reason/original reference, immutable history and duplicate protection, without enabling reward reversal or fabricated receipts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Primitive semantics](../contracts/ledger-service.md#primitive-semantics); [Plan §One financial boundary](../plan.md#one-financial-boundary).

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can each functional requirement be traced to a relevant story, measurable outcome and planned evidence location, including authority, safe output and invalid-input requirements beyond happy-path examples? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-035](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §SC-001–SC-007](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Plan §Test Strategy and Gates](../plan.md#test-strategy-and-gates).
- [ ] CHK016 Does SC-002 define measurable duplicate-credit/debit and competing-spend outcomes, with acceptance evidence distinguishing repeated delivery from genuine concurrent operations and specifying winner/loser effects? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Plan §Test Strategy and Gates, concurrency row](../plan.md#test-strategy-and-gates).
- [ ] CHK017 Does rollback acceptance explicitly cover a controlled failure after an earlier financial write and include postings, projections, allocations, durable outcomes, required audit and dependent owning-domain changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016–FR-017](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §SC-003](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Plan §Test Strategy and Gates, service row](../plan.md#test-strategy-and-gates).
- [ ] CHK018 Are calendar acceptance expectations objectively stated for inclusive/exclusive cutoffs, 365 weekday dates, weekend expiry, 72 counted hours and identical results under at least two host timezones? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 4](../spec.md#user-story-4---use-the-same-baghdad-business-boundaries-priority-p2); [Spec §SC-005](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Plan §Test Strategy and Gates](../plan.md#test-strategy-and-gates).
- [ ] CHK019 Do acceptance gates require actual added/extended tests and real migrated PostgreSQL evidence for constraints, rollback, races, reconciliation and fresh/populated/repeated upgrades, with missing evidence explicitly leaving the gate open? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, FR-035](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §SC-006](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Plan §Test Strategy and Gates](../plan.md#test-strategy-and-gates).

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are same-intent replay, changed-intent conflicts, new/missing client keys and identical textual keys across actor/operation scopes specified independently from durable business-source uniqueness? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018–FR-020](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Trusted context and identities](../contracts/ledger-service.md#trusted-context-and-identities).
- [ ] CHK021 Are replay requirements explicit about original accepted results and allocations, renewed observation authority, skipped financial/domain mutations and new-key alias bookkeeping without repeated mutation audit? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019–FR-020](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Replay and release outcomes](../contracts/ledger-service.md#replay-and-release-outcomes); [Plan §Identity, release and reconciliation](../plan.md#identity-release-and-reconciliation).
- [ ] CHK022 Are permitted outcomes specified for competing credits, independent debits, debit-versus-reservation and duplicate releases, including nonnegative components and unchanged losing-operation effects? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §User Story 3](../spec.md#user-story-3---apply-one-atomic-effect-despite-repeats-and-races-priority-p1).
- [ ] CHK023 Are pre-commit interruption and post-commit lost-reply recovery distinguished, with recoverable stable identity and no inference that an uncertain reply proves failure or permits reservation release? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, FR-017, FR-020](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Transaction protocol](../contracts/ledger-service.md#transaction-protocol).

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are all-or-nothing outcomes defined when an amount fits total ownership but exceeds unreserved or action-eligible funds, including mixed-source and Free/expired referral cases? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011–FR-013](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §Edge Cases](../spec.md#edge-cases).
- [ ] CHK025 Are eligibility changes after reservation addressed without altering its saved source allocation, with released referral ownership retained and new-withdrawal eligibility assessed separately? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012–FR-015](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §User Story 2, scenarios 3–4](../spec.md#user-story-2---preserve-fund-sources-through-spending-and-reservation-priority-p1).
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements explicit for wrong-wallet, already-closed and concurrently released allocations, and for an active reservation lacking trusted same-transaction safety evidence? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013–FR-015, FR-023](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Replay and release outcomes](../contracts/ledger-service.md#replay-and-release-outcomes).
- [ ] CHK027 Are missing/forged context, nonexistent owners, mismatched ownership and authority changes between an initial read and financial decision addressed with no mutation or private outcome disclosure? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, FR-023, FR-034](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Plan §Test Strategy and Gates](../plan.md#test-strategy-and-gates).

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Is a single atomic boundary required for financial and dependent domain effects, with concurrency protection and current-authority checks covering every participant while external provider/file operations remain outside it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, FR-021–FR-023](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Plan §One financial boundary](../plan.md#one-financial-boundary).
- [ ] CHK029 Are retention and immutability requirements complete for postings, operations, request bindings, original allocations and required audit, including protection against deletion through account/parent lifecycle changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-024, FR-026](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Data model §SQL guards, reconciliation and upgrade evidence](../data-model.md#sql-guards-reconciliation-and-upgrade-evidence).
- [ ] CHK030 Are safe error, audit and diagnostic projections specified with useful authorized references while excluding another owner's results, secrets, private financial/provider payloads and raw persistence errors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, FR-034](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Reconciliation, errors and diagnostics](../contracts/ledger-service.md#reconciliation-errors-and-diagnostics).

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Are responsibilities for verified events, action-specific eligibility and safe-release proof assigned to trusted owning domains, with P01 refusing pending/unverified credits or guessed releases and leaving provider reconciliation, settlement and restore in later phases? [Dependency, Spec §FR-008, FR-015](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §Assumptions](../spec.md#assumptions); [Internal contract §Primitive semantics](../contracts/ledger-service.md#primitive-semantics).
- [ ] CHK032 Are multi-wallet composition requirements clear about the complete participant set, one shared atomic outcome, independent per-wallet identities and owning-domain compound replay, so a recovered child operation cannot imply a successful rolled-back compound action? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016–FR-018](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Entry points and composition](../contracts/ledger-service.md#entry-points-and-composition); [Internal contract §Transaction protocol](../contracts/ledger-service.md#transaction-protocol).
- [ ] CHK033 Are migration and compatibility requirements explicit about preserving accounts, credentials, refresh relationships, existing checks and expanded inventories, without inventing legacy balances, provisioning production wallets or weakening retained-history protections for fixture cleanup? [Dependency, Spec §FR-006, FR-026, FR-035](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Plan §Project Structure](../plan.md#project-structure); [Data model §SQL guards, reconciliation and upgrade evidence](../data-model.md#sql-guards-reconciliation-and-upgrade-evidence).

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK034 Are retry categories, maximum attempts and exhaustion outcomes defined consistently, separating recognized transient conflicts from insufficient funds, authority denial, changed intent and business conflicts without claiming unresolved work succeeded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, FR-022](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Internal contract §Transaction protocol](../contracts/ledger-service.md#transaction-protocol).
- [ ] CHK035 Are reconciliation requirements and acceptance outcomes explicit about operation magnitudes and complete posting sets as well as source/state projections and active allocations, so missing or mismatched per-operation amounts cannot remain unexplained? [Gap, Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-025](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §SC-007](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Internal contract §Reconciliation, errors and diagnostics](../contracts/ledger-service.md#reconciliation-errors-and-diagnostics); [Data model §LedgerPosting](../data-model.md#ledgerposting---ledger_postings); [Engineering §Exact Money and Source Provenance](../../../docs/engineering/data-patterns.md#exact-money-and-source-provenance).
- [ ] CHK036 Is reconciliation's consistent read-only scope explicit, including exact cumulative-history arithmetic and mismatch reporting without silently rewriting history, balances or source classification? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025](../spec.md#functional-requirements); [Spec §SC-007](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes); [Plan §Identity, release and reconciliation](../plan.md#identity-release-and-reconciliation).

## Notes

- Review CHK010 and CHK035 first: the planned fractional-hour example needs an explicit precision contract, and operation-amount reconciliation needs evidence beyond wallet/allocation aggregate agreement. These questions do not prescribe an unapproved policy or amend the spec/plan.
- Every item requires reviewer evidence; generation and documentation-reference checks do not approve any item or establish implementation readiness.
- Preserve existing checklist content and IDs. Any later addition to this checklist starts at CHK037.
